releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.14 — a layout sweep. Call history rows are rebuilt: every card now uses the same three-line structure (name, direction + call-type pill, time + duration) with a fixed avatar column and a uniform 76dp minimum height, so a long label or a big system font can no longer squeeze the duration into a vertical stack of digits or stretch a card. The same single-line rules were applied across statuses, friends, groups, members, settings and the call overlays, and every tab now shares the same 12dp gutters and 8dp row gaps, so Chats, Groups, Status, Discover and History line up with each other.
